<thought>Search the template catalog using the correct functional group names: “ketones” and “C‑C triple bonds” are the groups that are broken in the forward reaction. Also specify the bond changes (C‑O broken, C‑C formed).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
